name: runtime-resolution
argv: import sys,json,importlib; names=['pytest','pytest_asyncio','asyncpg','sqlalchemy','alembic','fastapi','pydantic','boto3','botocore','s3transfer','dramatiq','redis']; print(json.dumps({'executable':sys.executable,'sys_path':sys.path,'modules':{n:{'path':importlib.import_module(n).__file__,'version':getattr(importlib.import_module(n),'__version__',None)} for n in names}},indent=2)); from apps.api.main import app; print('Application import success')
command: /opt/miniconda3/bin/python -c 'import sys,json,importlib; names=['"'"'pytest'"'"','"'"'pytest_asyncio'"'"','"'"'asyncpg'"'"','"'"'sqlalchemy'"'"','"'"'alembic'"'"','"'"'fastapi'"'"','"'"'pydantic'"'"','"'"'boto3'"'"','"'"'botocore'"'"','"'"'s3transfer'"'"','"'"'dramatiq'"'"','"'"'redis'"'"']; print(json.dumps({'"'"'executable'"'"':sys.executable,'"'"'sys_path'"'"':sys.path,'"'"'modules'"'"':{n:{'"'"'path'"'"':importlib.import_module(n).__file__,'"'"'version'"'"':getattr(importlib.import_module(n),'"'"'__version__'"'"',None)} for n in names}},indent=2)); from apps.api.main import app; print('"'"'Application import success'"'"')'
